newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank of Bangkok closes US$20 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank of Bangkok closes US$20 mln FRN.

text.p: Union Bank of Bangkok's US$20 million subordinated floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger KDB Asia said.
The facility has a final maturity of five and a half years with no put or call options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 150 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR).
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 202.5 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$3 million each, are KDB Asia and Peregrine Fixed Income.
Managers are Hanmi Leasing and Finance, Kumho Merchant Bank, Daehan Investment Banking Corp, Hyundai International Merchant Bank, KDLC Singapore and Kyongnam Merchant Bank.
